in_marathi.name: Jaidul
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaidul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jai: victory, Dul: God. The name Jaidul is derived from the Sanskrit language, and it is a powerful name in Hindu tradition. It is believed that the name Jaidul is given to a child who will be victorious in all aspects of life, with the blessings and support of God.
